card: The Heatmap is a worst-first list: pivot cells into a tone×tier by segment×audience map
tests_added: apps/console/src/pages/simulator/model.test.ts::pivots one instrument's 36 cells into 6 rows by 6 columns, tiers in model order, audiences ascending
apps/console/src/pages/simulator/model.test.ts::keeps two instrument hashes as two blocks, never one merged grid
apps/console/src/pages/simulator/model.test.ts::marks a combination absent from results 'not run': no figure, no held, out of every marginal
apps/console/src/pages/simulator/model.test.ts::sums a row's counted fails, evaluated checks and judged runs, and says how many of its cells are thin
apps/console/src/pages/simulator/model.test.ts::marks a cell whose red-line rule failed
apps/console/src/pages/simulator/model.test.ts::colours a cell by the row's held derivation over its own runs: the run-weighted cells give back the row's held
apps/console/src/pages/simulator/layer2.test.tsx::maps the cells as a keyboard grid: tone × tier by segment × audience, one tab stop, Enter opens the cell
apps/console/src/pages/simulator/layer2.test.tsx::selects the routed cell on the map, with its detail and the worst-first table beneath
deviations_from_card: (1) The component is CellMap.tsx, not Matrix.tsx: Matrix.tsx and matrix.ts collide on Windows' case-insensitive filesystem (vite resolved ./Matrix to matrix.ts, the component import was undefined). (2) Cell colour: per the coordinator's 'no third way', a position is coloured by the TournamentRow.held derivation (mean over judged runs of RunRow.health) applied to the cell's own runs, not the pooled checks; a test proves the run-weighted cells give back row.held exactly. This needs one extra runs.page chain per heatmap tournament (unfiltered); a run carries no instrument hash, so a coordinate shared by two blocks gets no colour rather than a guessed one. (3) Marginal cells are role=gridcell but outside the roving arrow set; the tests count positions by data-pos. (4) 8 cases for the card's 7 (the held-identity case added). (5) tableView memory not used: the map is a grid with no sort/filter state, and the worst-first FilterTable stays mounted across cell routes.
notes: One commit (tests + implementation together: the tests import matrix.ts). An earlier full-suite run showed 4 red in src/pages/reconcile/layer2.test.tsx (sibling console-reconcile-page A in flight); the final full run was 601/601 green. No budget raise; simulator.l2 css is at 15.5 KiB of a 16,000 B line, so the next simulator css addition will likely need one. testgen.ts unchanged.
